metadata.title: That 1 lucky shot Valorant gave me while I was busy questioning reality
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was just guessing.
Enemy probably uninstalling out of confusion.
Valorant logic: handing out kills when you least expect it.
Who needs skills when bugs do the work?

Tap if you’ve ever got a kill you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
